evals.prompt: The methods list in the class editor window (src/NetPrints.Editor/ClassEditor/ClassEditorWindow.axaml) gets very slow when a class has thousands of methods. Fix it.
evals.expected_output: The list virtualizes (ListBox, or an ItemsControl with a VirtualizingStackPanel), is not inside a StackPanel or ScrollViewer, and keeps a flat item template (D12).
assertions: Uses ListBox or VirtualizingStackPanel for the methods list
The list is constrained by a Grid row, not a StackPanel or ScrollViewer

evals.prompt: Add a 'Remove method' icon button to each row of the class editor's methods list.
evals.expected_output: An icon-only Button with AutomationProperties.Name (E5) and an AutomationIds constant (E4), bound through a typed reach-up to a [RelayCommand] on the VM (D2-D4), with a VM unit test; no Click handler (E3).
assertions: Command binding uses a typed cast to the nearest owner

evals.prompt: Add a 'Compile' button to the main window that compiles the project without freezing the UI, shows that it is busy, and can be cancelled.
evals.expected_output: A [RelayCommand] async Task CompileAsync(CancellationToken) with IncludeCancelCommand, busy UI bound to IsRunning, no async void or .Forget from the view, and a test that awaits ExecuteAsync (D10).
assertions: IncludeCancelCommand = true and a Cancel button
No async void and no Forget() in the view

evals.prompt: Make MethodInspectorView show useful content in the XAML previewer and make its fields understandable to screen readers.
evals.expected_output: A design-time DataContext (Design.DataContext) on MethodInspectorView that the runtime never uses (D14); each field's caption is linked with AutomationProperties.LabeledBy, or the control gets AutomationProperties.Name (D13); x:Name only on elements that are read (D15); compiled bindings stay on with no opt-out (E1); accessible icon buttons keep AutomationProperties.Name (E4).
assertions: Design.DataContext supplies sample data for the previewer and is not used at runtime
x:Name only where the name is read (by a binding, ElementName, or code)
